scene.placeText: the old sign yard of her far-future city beneath its transparent dome at night — towering mid-century signs of starbursts, arrows and giant shells all around, some still dark and some relit tube by tube in pink, cyan and gold, with no letters on any of them
scene.ownProp: a short salvaged sign tube bent into a starburst, glowing pink and cyan, held up beside her slender glass restoration wand
scene.outfit: a sign-restorer look fitted to her body — a cropped pale chrome jacket studded along every edge with tiny warm marquee bulbs worn open over a fitted bandeau top, crossing harness straps traced with thin glowing pink and cyan tubes, high-cut fitted shorts, starburst earrings of salvaged sign glass and tall boots
scene.scene: she is the sign restorer, standing on the gravel among the giant signs and lifting a freshly relit glass tube up against the dark sky to check its glow, an amused look in her eyes

prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same adult American woman — the personification of Las Vegas — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
SKIN FINISH: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the attached image, not a generic pretty face.

World: an ordinary day in Las Vegas as her world knows it — a far-future city two centuries from now: sleek curved architecture, smart glowing materials, holographic interfaces, layered levels of the city and quiet flying vehicles; even an everyday place is rebuilt in that future, not today's Las Vegas with neon added. This is her world's own everyday life, not our present day: every made thing around her — tools, cups, lamps, signs, vehicles, money and devices — is made the way her world makes them.
Let the place itself carry this world through its materials, fittings and objects; do not add the city's landmarks, towers, giant holograms or a skyline unless the place below names them.

Place: the old sign yard of her far-future city beneath its transparent dome at night — towering mid-century signs of starbursts, arrows and giant shells all around, some still dark and some relit tube by tube in pink, cyan and gold, with no letters on any of them
Light direction: side light — the light falls from one side, the far side of her face in soft shadow.
Outfit: a sign-restorer look fitted to her body — a cropped pale chrome jacket studded along every edge with tiny warm marquee bulbs worn open over a fitted bandeau top, crossing harness straps traced with thin glowing pink and cyan tubes, high-cut fitted shorts, starburst earrings of salvaged sign glass and tall boots, worn with maximal styling presence — the chosen outfit worn in its most revealing version — a deep neckline with natural cleavage, bare shoulders, a cropped or open-back cut, a short hem or high slit showing the thighs, as far as the outfit allows, skin clearly showing, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
Her clothes are her world's everyday techwear — the chosen outfit keeps its cut, cover and skin, but is made of technical fabrics with reflective panels, glowing seam lines, magnetic clasps and chunky-soled boots.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a chest-up shot of her face, shoulders and expression; body in side profile, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; head tilted slightly; camera slightly below, looking up at her.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her near arm, on the camera side; one unbroken arm from shoulder to hand, its forearm never hidden by a sleeve, bow or ornament.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a short salvaged sign tube bent into a starburst, glowing pink and cyan, held up beside her slender glass restoration wand up beside her face; it is all she holds.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: slightly furrowed brow, softened eyes, lips lightly pressed together.
Scene note: she is the sign restorer, standing on the gravel among the giant signs and lifting a freshly relit glass tube up against the dark sky to check its glow, an amused look in her eyes

Framing: a chest-up shot — the bottom edge crosses just below her bust; waist, hips and legs are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia — and leave behind the object she holds in it; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

SIGNATURE ACCESSORY: her world's signature object — a slender glass restoration wand whose tip pulses with cyan light — appears only as one small accessory shaped after it (a charm, brooch, pendant or hair ornament) or set down beside her in the scene; she does not hold it unless PROP names it.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, numbers, logo or watermark. Any animal or creature that belongs to the place stays separate from her at its own natural scale — never touching, held by or merged with her body.
